description: This file defines the Product entity class in a Java e-commerce application, including its properties, relationships, and JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Entity representing a product with properties such as descriptions, availability, attributes, images, relationships, and associated metadata like SKU, dimensions, and category associations.
